paragraphs: Weatherford International plc, an Irish public limited company, together with its subsidiaries ("Weatherford," the "Company," "we," "us" and "our"), is a leading global energy services company providing equipment and services used in the drilling, evaluation, well construction, completion, production, intervention, and responsible abandonment of wells in the oil and natural gas exploration and production industry as well as new energy platforms.

We conduct business in approximately 75 countries, answering the challenges of the energy industry with approximately 305 operating locations including manufacturing, research and development, service, and training facilities. Our operational performance is reviewed and managed across the life cycle of the well, and we report in three segments (1) Drilling and Evaluation, (2) Well Construction and Completions, and (3) Production and Intervention.

Our principal executive offices are located at 2000 St. James Place, Houston, Texas 77056, and our telephone number at that location is +1.713.836.4000. Our internet address is www.weatherford.com. General information about us, including our corporate governance policies, code of business conduct and charters for the committees of our Board of Directors, can be found on our website, and such information provided on our website, is not incorporated by reference into this Form 10-K. On our website we make available, free of charge, our annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K, proxy statements and amendments to those reports filed or furnished as soon as reasonably practicable after we electronically file or furnish them to the Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC"). The SEC maintains a website that contains our reports, proxy and information statements, and our other SEC filings. The address of that site is www.sec.gov.

Our objective is to create value for our shareholders across industry cycles by ensuring sustainable profitability and cash flow generation. We aim to accomplish this goal with a comprehensive suite of products and services, differentiated technologies, strong customer focus, operational rigor, disciplined capital management, and a commitment to safety and operational efficiency.

Our customers' objectives are continually evolving and are currently focused on disciplined capital and operational expenditures, generating investor and shareholder returns, reducing emissions, participating in the energy transition, and enhancing safety. We have aligned our technology development, capital spending and operations around these objectives and expanded our role as a market leading provider of solutions that assist our customers in addressing their key operational challenges, not just in conventional reservoirs but also in mature fields, unconventionals, offshore, and in digitalization and automation.

paragraphs: An investment in our securities involves various risks. You should consider carefully all the risk factors described below, the matters discussed herein under "Forward-Looking Statements" and other information included and incorporated by reference in this Form 10-K, as well as in other reports and materials that we file with the SEC. If any of the risks described below, or elsewhere in this Form 10-K, were to materialize, our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and or prospects could be materially adversely affected. In such case, the trading price of our ordinary shares could decline, and investors could lose part or all of their investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also materially adversely affect our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

Our business is dependent on capital spending by our customers which is greatly affected by fluctuations in oil and natural gas prices and the availability and cost of capital; reductions in capital spending by our customers has had, and could continue to have, an adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.

Demand for our products and services is tied to the level of exploration, development and production activity and the corresponding capital and operating spending by oil and natural gas exploration and production companies, including national oil companies. The level of exploration, development and production activity is directly affected by fluctuations in oil and natural gas prices, which historically have been volatile and are likely to continue to be volatile in the future, especially given current geopolitical and economic conditions. Low oil and natural gas prices and decline in global demand for oil and natural gas, including reduced demand as a result of a pandemic, have previously led to our customers, including national oil companies and large oil and natural gas exploration and production companies, to greatly reduce planned future capital expenditures. The following discussion should be read in conjunction with the earlier section "Item 1. Business" and our Consolidated Financial Statements and Notes thereto included later in "Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data." Our discussion includes various forward-looking statements about our markets, the demand for our products and services and our future results. These statements include certain risks and uncertainties. For information about these risks and uncertainties, refer to the section entitled "Forward-Looking Statements" and the section entitled "Item 1A. Risk Factors." The following section generally discusses our financial condition and results of operations for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 compared to fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. Please refer to our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024 filed with the SEC on February 6, 2025, for a discussion regarding our financial condition and results of operations for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 as compared to fiscal year ended December 31, 2023.

Demand for our industry's products and services is driven by many factors, including commodity prices, the number of oil and gas rigs and wells drilled, depth and drilling conditions of wells, number of well completions, age of existing wells, reservoir depletion, regulatory environment, and the level of workover activity worldwide.

Lower oil and natural gas prices and lower rig count generally correlate to lower exploration and production spending, and higher oil and natural gas prices and higher rig count generally correlate to higher exploration and production spending. Therefore, our financial results are significantly affected by oil and natural gas prices as well as rig counts. As shown in the following tables, as of December 31, 2025 oil prices and rig counts were notably lower than at December 31, 2024. The drop in oil prices and rig counts since December 31, 2024 has coincided with reduced activity levels across our industry. Henry Hub natural gas prices increased as of December 31, 2025 compared to December 31, 2024, driven by both U.S. domestic gas demand and investment decisions on adding new export liquified natural gas capacity. Gas production additions, largely driven by positive liquified natural gas sentiment ahead of actual capacity additions, were sourced from a backlog of drilled but uncompleted wells and deferred start-ups.

In addition, there may be future impacts and effects on our industry in areas relating to global trade policy and tariffs, global conflicts and resulting sanctions, environmental regulation and others. As tariffs and trade policies continue to develop, the Company actively monitors for changes and adjusts operations to mitigate impacts. While they created some degree of margin dilution, tariffs did not have a material impact on the Company during the year ended December 31, 2025.

Revenues totaled $4,918 million in 2025, a decrease of $595 million, or 11% compared to 2024. Year-over-year in 2025, product revenues decreased 9% and service revenues decreased 12%. DRE, PRI and WCC were responsible for 52%, 19% and 17% of the decrease in revenues, respectively, with the remaining decrease from lower activity in integrated services and projects. Geographically, each region saw a decrease in revenue, with Latin America responsible for 83% of the decline, North America 11%, Europe/Sub-Sahara Africa/Russia 5% and Middle East/North Africa/Asia 1%. Year-over-year revenue decreases were primarily caused by a softening of the overall market which drove a decline in activity across segments and geographies.

Operating income of $756 million in the twelve months ended December 31, 2025, decreased 19% compared to $938 million in the twelve months ended December 31, 2024, primarily due to the decline in revenue, with a partial offset from lower cost of products and services, lower selling general, administrative and research and development costs and a gain on the sale of our pressure pumping business in Argentina. Cost of products and services of $3.38 billion decreased $221 million, or 6%, in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to the decline in product sales and a reduction in headcount leading to lower personnel costs. Our cost of products and services as a percentage of revenues was 69% in 2025 compared to 65% in 2024. The higher cost ratio was primarily due to fixed costs decreasing at a slower rate than revenues.

paragraphs: Weatherford International plc, 一間愛爾蘭公開有限公司，與其子公司（"Weatherford," "本公司," "我們," "我們"及"我們的"），為全球領先的能源服務公司，提供用於油氣探勘與生產業界以及新興能源平台之鑽井、評估、井建造、完井、生產、幹擾及負責任棄置井所使用之設備與服務。
我們在約75個國家進行業務，透過約305個營運據點（包括製造、研究與開發、服務及訓練設施）應對能源產業的挑戰。我們的營運表現會根據井的全生命週期進行評估與管理，並分為三個應報告分部（1）鑽井與評估、（2）井建造與完井、（3）生產與幹擾。

本公司主要營業據點位於德州休士頓聖詹姆斯大路 2000 號，郵遞區號 77056，該處電話號碼為 +1.713.836.4000。本公司網站網址為 www.weatherford.com。有關本公司之一般資訊，包括公司治理政策、商業行為準則及董事會各委員會章程，可於本公司網站取得，但網站所提供之資訊未經引用成為本 10-K 表式之組成部分。本公司網站提供免費取得本公司年度 10-K 表式報告、季報 10-Q 表式報告、現況報告 8-K 表式報告、股東週年大會資料及上述報告之修正版本，本公司於電子檔提交或提供給證券交易委員會（"SEC"）後盡速提供。證券交易委員會維護一個網站，提供本公司報告、股東週年大會資料及資訊說明書，以及本公司其他 SEC 檔案。該網站網址為 www.sec.gov。
我們的目標是透過確保可持續獲利與現金流產生，在產業週期中為股東創造價值。我們透過一套完整的產品與服務、差異化的技術、強大的客戶導向、營運嚴謹、審慎的資本管理及對安全與營運效率的承諾來達成此目標。
我們的客戶目標持續演進，目前聚焦於審慎的資本與營運支出、產生投資人與股東回報、減少排放、參與能源轉型，以及提升安全。我們已根據這些目標來調整技術發展、資本支出與營運，並擴大我們作為市場領導者之角色，提供協助客戶解決關鍵營運挑戰的解決方案，不僅在傳統儲層，也在成熟油田、非常規資源、海上及數位化與自動化領域。
我們的重點在於落實我們五大戰略優先事項：
•透過直接回應客戶對提高效率、價值創造與安全之需求來提升客戶體驗；
•透過持續投資研究與開發及建設我們的數位與新
•組織活力以激勵員工參與、吸引並留住人才、發展我們的人力資源
•精簡運作以簡化流程並驅動業務中浪費的消除，以提高生產力與品質
•財務表現能驅動價值創造，跨越總體經濟週期，並實現可持續的獲利能力、現金流產生與業界領先的資本回報

•透過強固的資產負債表，提升業務在週期中的韌性；

我們產業之產品與服務之需求受到許多因素影響，包括商品價格、油氣鑽井 rigs 數量與鑽井井數、井之深度與鑽井條件、井之完井數量、現有井之年齡、儲層耗竭、法規環境以及全球之工作過井活動程度。

較低之油氣價格與較低之 rigs 數量通常與較低之探採支出相關，而較高之油氣價格與較高之 rigs 數量通常與較高之探採支出相關。因此，我們之財務結果受到油氣價格以及 rigs 數量之顯著影響。如後述表格所示，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，油價與 rigs 數量明顯低於 2024 年 12 月 31 日。自 2024 年 12 月 31 日以來，油價與 rigs 數量之下降與我們產業之活動水平下降同時發生。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，亨利中心天然氣價格較 2024 年 12 月 31 日為高，此為美國國內天然氣需求增加以及增加新出口液化天然氣容量之投資決策所驅動。天然氣生產增加，主要由正面液化天然氣情緒所驅動，而實際容量增加尚未實現，這些增加來自於已鑽但未完井之井之積壓以及延後啟動之項目。

2025 年營業收入總計為 49.18 億美元，較 2024 年減少 5.95 億美元，或 11%。與 2024 年相比，2025 年產品收入減少 9%，服務收入減少 12%。DRE、PRI 和 WCC 分別對收入減少負有 52%、19% 和 17% 的責任，其餘減少來自整合服務與專案活動減少。從地理區域來看，各區域均出現收入減少，其中拉丁美洲佔 83%，北美佔 11%，歐洲/撒哈拉以南非洲/俄羅斯佔 5%，中東/北非/亞洲佔 1%。與 2024 年相比，收入減少主要由於總體經濟環境趨於疲軟，導致各個業務部門與地理區域的活動減少。

營業收入為 756 百萬美元，為 2025 年 12 月 31 日止十二個月之數字，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日止十二個月之 938 百萬美元減少 19%，主要由於營業收入下降，部分抵銷因素為產品及服務成本降低、銷售一般及行政費用與研究與發展費用降低，以及阿根廷壓力泵業務出售所產生之獲利。產品及服務成本為 3.38 十億美元，較 2024 年減少 221 百萬美元，或 6%，主要由於產品銷售減少及人數減少導致人力成本降低。我們的產品及服務成本佔營業收入百分比為 2025 年 69%，較 2024 年 65% 高。較高的成本比率主要由於固定成本減少速度低於營業收入減少速度。

paragraphs: 投資本公司的證券涉及多種風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險因素、 herein 所討論的 "Forward-Looking Statements" 以及包含於本 Form 10-K 中的其他資訊，以及我們向 SEC 提交的其他報告與資料。若下列所描述的風險，或本 Form 10-K 其他地方所提及的風險實現，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流及前景造成重大不利影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的交易價格可能下跌，投資人可能損失部分或全部投資。此外，目前尚未知悉或本公司認為不重要的其他風險與不確定因素，也可能對本公司財務狀況、營運結果及現金流造成重大不利影響。
本公司業務依賴客戶的資本支出，而此支出受油氣價格波動及資金可取得性與成本的影響極大；客戶資本支出減少已對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運結果造成不利影響，並可能持續造成不利影響。

對本公司產品與服務的需求與油氣探勘、開發與生產活動的水準以及油氣探勘與生產公司，包括國家油公司，所進行的資本與營運支出相關。探勘、開發與生產活動的水準直接受到油氣價格波動的影響，而歷史上的油氣價格波動極大，未來可能持續波動，尤其在當前地緣政治與經濟條件下更為明顯。低油氣價格與全球對油氣需求的下降，包括因疫情導致需求減少，已導致本公司客戶，包括國家油公司與大型油氣探勘與生產公司，大幅減少預計未來的資本支出。影響油氣價格的因素包括但不限於：
